content:
Hi! So I am a fairly new player (I started playing during Saya collab) and I got really lucky with my pulls to the point I probably have "some" decent teams to use. Right now, I've completed the boss on arc 1 chapter 9 (so I'll be starting arc 2 ) and was wondering if someone could help me out and let me know what would be the best teams for all 4 realms and most likely something that can easily clear chapter 2 / help me clear chapter 1 stages without losing much hp (I've been using helot catena for the most part so it was hard to remain at high HP during bosses).

I'd gladly appreciate any help and in case one of the "standard units" will be missng, I still can take 2 characters from Protoparadise thingy.

So in general, I'd like to ask for:
4 teams for 4 different types of realms (ideally for D-zone)
One team to clear Arc 2 stages (or at least early ones)
One team to not lose as much HP to get the missing achievements from Arc 1 stages

Thanks a lot in advance!
thread_title: Help with team comps for all realms

content:
Your ghelot team looks strong enough to clear the entirety of arc2 and except for c5 hard mode. She struggles specifically in that chapter due to the mechanic of the chapter.

If you want an easy team to clear, run glotan saya helot thais. Helot/thais is better for stage bosses, aigis/hameln for the rest. This team will breeze through even hard mode story
